about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

A sheet metal brake bends sheet by clamping it under a straight beam and swinging a folding leaf up around the edge: no punch and die, no marks on painted sheet, and long, straight bends in thin material. From the largest machines to the smallest: hydraulic, electric and CNC folding machines for 10 ga over 10 ft and production panels, box and pan brakes with removable fingers, straight brakes and foot-clamp folders, magnetic brakes that fold boxes of any depth, portable roofing and siding brakes for the job site and 3-in-1 shear, brake and roll machines.
